tail_observation.interpretation: Unfiltered empirical interpolated P99 from twenty observations; regression retained; insufficient to establish stable population tail.

interpretation.definition: Observed mean of pinned descriptor preparation + required H2D + native shared producer + sixteen sequential private attention occurrences + final join is lower by 288.974475 us (5.6650253%) across the predeclared four representatives.
interpretation.causal_attribution: Fresh-process AB/BA is block pairing and retains possible process/time drift; does not prove absolute causal effect or isolate FD merge from row assignment.
interpretation.scope: Four fixed canonical representatives; synthetic resident Q/K/V; no full 128-step trajectory, dense/model/sampler/serving, or split-parallel-versus-padding end-to-end result.
interpretation.claim_allowed: An observed bounded, producer-inclusive attention-chain mean improvement under these controls.
claims_not_supported: Benefit on every round or sample
interpretation.tail_counterexample_diagnosis: The single capacity256 slower pair has wall and queue regressions, so it cannot be dismissed as preparation-only host delay. No timeline isolates the cause.
interpretation.slower_pair_concentration: All ten wall-loss pairs occur in trial1 (zero-based); other three rounds each win20/20. This process-block concentration reinforces the between-process/order-drift limitation.
